response:
I implemented both halves of #180 in this checkout. Nothing is committed or pushed. **`npm run typecheck` passes with no errors**, and so do `npm run build` and the 136 focused tests. Nothing was checked in a browser. Two things need your attention first:

- **Build churn is still in the tree.** The build changed `public/data/_bank.generated.json`, `public/data/finder-address-index.json` and `supabase/functions/mcp/index.ts`. My `git checkout --` to restore them was denied. They have nothing to do with this work; leave them out of the release or restore them.
- **I edited `ProfileSection.tsx`, which wasn't on the ownership list.** The study settings actually live there, not in `AccountView.tsx` or `PrepSection.tsx`. I didn't need to touch those two. It's not on the forbidden list either, and the change is small: its timing, question-pool and AI cards now hand off to one new component.

## Prescribed week
- **Students:** My Work → To do now opens with one real week. Each day has its tasks numbered in Joshua's order, with the saved status and his time estimate. A missing estimate says "No time estimate". Totals say how many tasks have no estimate, and the page states what counts as finished (skipped tasks don't count).
- **Opening a task changes nothing.** A linked drill opens its start page, linked homework opens its assignment page, and anything else opens the task's own page. A test confirms nothing is written.
- **Which week shows:** the week containing today, else the next one, else the most recent. The student's private to-do list is stored as a weekly plan and could be picked up as a prescribed week before; it no longer can. The read is also limited to the student's own plans.
- **Home changes too.** Home's week strip uses the same read, so it picks up the new week choice. I didn't edit Home itself.
- **Teacher page:**
  - Each existing plan expands to show the same week the student sees, built by the same code, with no student links.
  - New tasks start with no estimate instead of a pre-filled 30 minutes.
  - Loading a stored or pasted schedule asks before it replaces tasks already in the builder.
  - Curriculum suggestions are labelled as suggestions.
  - Tasks can be moved up or down within a day, and the published order matches what the builder shows.
  - The publish notification now links to the week on My Work instead of Classroom.

## Settings
- **Settings are now per account.** They were shared by every account on a device, and still live only in the browser. Old shared settings go to the first account that signs in, so a student's extra time isn't lost; a second account starts from the defaults. Nothing is deleted.
- **Each control says what it does.** Timing applies only to sections started later; a running section keeps its clock. The pool text matches how drills actually pick questions and says past answers and history don't change.
- **Failed saves are shown honestly.** If the browser refuses to save, the page says so and offers "Try saving again". Later edits build on the unsaved ones.
- **I removed the five AI and voice-coach switches.** Nothing in the app reads them, and the voice coach is switched off in code. Their saved values are kept.
- The days-before-repeat box no longer resets to 30 while you type; a bad value shows an error and isn't saved. "New questions first" now works with repeats off, because drills use it then too.

## Proof
- **Tests:** 7 new test files plus 7 related existing ones: 136 tests pass. They cover account switching A→B→A and logout while mounted, two failed saves then a retry, an update from the previous account being ignored, bad and old stored settings, plan ordering, unknown estimates, and links.
- **Full suite:** 15 test files fail, in activity-centre, timed content, booking, AcademyMainhub and standaloneDrillHistory. None of them import anything I changed, but I didn't run them on the unmodified code, so that's unproven.
- **Lint:** two warnings, both from code that was already there.

## Blocked or not done
- Denied: the git restore above, a shell pipeline (I used Grep instead), and a Python edit script (I made the same edits by hand).
- Not verified: browser checks (Codex owns those), touch and narrow screens, and two-tab sync, which isn't implemented.
- The teacher page's confirm and reorder buttons are tested only through their helper functions, not the page itself.
- No text-size or contrast setting exists on the Account page; those controls live in the question runners, so I added none.
- Teachers still can't edit a plan after publishing; that ability didn't exist before.
- Richer feedback or review settings would need runner changes, so they stay open, as does #180 as a whole.

## Files
- **Changed:** `src/hooks/useWeeklyPlan.ts`, `src/contexts/UserSettingsContext.tsx`, `src/pages/teacher/TeacherWeeklyPlans.tsx`, `src/pages/MyWorkPage.tsx`, `src/pages/MyWorkPage.refetch.test.tsx` (it now stubs out the new week component), `src/components/classroom/account/ProfileSection.tsx`
- **New:** in `src/lib/`: `weeklyPlanWeek.ts`, `weeklyPlanBuilder.ts`, `studySettings.ts`. In `src/components/classroom/`: `PrescribedWeek.tsx`, `account/StudySettingsSection.tsx`. Each has a matching test, plus `src/contexts/UserSettingsContext.test.tsx`.
